IN.authority_name: Passport Seva · Consular, Passport & Visa Division, Ministry of External Affairs

jurisdictions.name: Domestic (Regional Passport Offices & PSK/POPSK)
Overseas Consular Services (Indian Embassies & Consulates via VFS/BLS)

eligibility.rule: Must be a citizen of India by birth, descent, registration, or naturalization.
Minors require parental consent through Annexure D/C.

steps.step: Register and create an account on Passport Seva Online Portal (passportindia.gov.in).
Fill out Form for Fresh Passport online and submit.
Pay the application fee online (SBI / NetBanking / UPI / Credit/Debit) and schedule appointment at nearest PSK or Post Office PSK (POPSK).
Attend in-person appointment with original supporting documents for biometric capture and document verification.
Undergo police verification at your local police jurisdiction.
Receive passport delivered by India Post Speed Post.

documents.document_name: Proof of Date of Birth (Birth Certificate, School Leaving Certificate, PAN card, Aadhaar card, or Service Record)
documents.conditions: Birth Certificate issued by municipal authority / Registrar of Births is standard; for applicants born on or after 26/01/1989, standard municipal/Panchayat birth certificate or Aadhaar/PAN is accepted under current relaxed MEA rules.
accepted_alternatives: PAN Card issued by Income Tax Dept
Policy Bond issued by Public Life Insurance Corporation
documents.translation_or_legalisation: English or Hindi official translation if in regional language

documents.document_name: Proof of Present Address (Aadhaar, Electricity/Water bill, Bank Passbook, Rent agreement, Employer cert)
documents.conditions: Must reflect residence for the immediate past 1 continuous year; if moved recently, multiple proofs covering the full 1-year period are mandatory.
accepted_alternatives: Water bill / Electricity bill (at least 2 consecutive bills within last year)
Passbook of running bank account (Scheduled Public/Private bank)

documents.document_name: Proof of Non-ECR (Emigration Check Not Required) Status
documents.conditions: Required if applicant has passed 10th standard (Matriculation) or above, is a taxpayer, or meets other Non-ECR categories; without this, passport issued with ECR stamp.
accepted_alternatives: Income Tax Assessment Order / returns for last 1 year

photo_rules.exception_for_infants: Infants under age 5 must bring a physical 4.5 cm x 3.5 cm colour photo with plain white background, neutral expression, ears visible.

processing_times.tatkaal_days: 1 to 3 working days post police verification status

eligibility.rule: Can apply within 1 year before expiry or up to 3 years after expiry without pre-police verification in most cases.
Expired more than 3 years requires fresh police verification before issuance.

steps.step: Log into Passport Seva, choose 'Re-issue of Passport'.
Provide previous passport details and reason for re-issue (Validity Expired / Exhaustion of Pages / Change in Personal Particulars).
Pay fee, book slot, and bring old original passport for physical cancellation.

documents.conditions: Must bring old passport booklet; will be cancelled and returned with the new booklet.
documents.original_or_copy: Original + self-attested copies of first 2 and last 2 pages, including ECR/Non-ECR page and observation page

documents.conditions: Required even if address is unchanged from the old passport.

eligibility.rule: Mandatory police report (FIR or Police Missing Certificate) required for any lost or stolen passport.

steps.step: Immediately lodge an FIR or Missing Report at the nearest police station or state police online portal.
Submit online application for Re-issue under 'Lost / Stolen' category.
Attach signed Annexure F explaining circumstances of loss.

documents.document_name: Police Report / FIR Copy (or official Lost Report Certificate)
documents.conditions: Must specify passport number, date, and place of loss.
documents.original_or_copy: Original police report with official stamp and signature
documents.translation_or_legalisation: Official translation if in regional language

documents.conditions: Specifying how and when the passport was lost.

eligibility.rule: Minor spelling correction: requires 2 public identification documents showing correct spelling.
Major name change / gender change: requires official Gazette Notification and 2 prominent newspaper advertisements.
Name change due to marriage / divorce: self-declaration / marriage cert under current MEA rules without gazette.

steps.step: Publish name change in Official Gazette of India (or state gazette) if major change.
Publish notices in 2 daily newspapers (one local language, one English).
Apply for Reissue with 'Change in Personal Particulars'.

documents.document_name: Gazette Notification / Marriage Certificate / Newspaper Clippings
documents.conditions: Depends on whether name change is clerical, post-marriage, or total name change.
accepted_alternatives: Marriage Certificate issued by Registrar of Marriages
documents.original_or_copy: Original Gazette or clipping + self-attested copies

sources.publisher: Ministry of External Affairs, Government of India

US.authority_name: U.S. Department of State · Bureau of Consular Affairs

jurisdictions.name: Domestic (Passport Acceptance Facilities / Regional Passport Agencies)
Overseas Consular Services (U.S. Embassies & Consulates)

eligibility.rule: Must be a U.S. citizen or non-citizen U.S. national.
Must apply in person using Form DS-11 at an authorized Passport Acceptance Facility.

steps.step: Complete Form DS-11: Application For a U.S. Passport (do not sign until instructed by acceptance agent).
Gather evidence of U.S. citizenship (original/certified copy + photocopy).
Present valid government photo ID + front/back photocopy.
Provide one compliant 2x2 inch color passport photo.
Pay application fee to U.S. Department of State and execution fee to acceptance facility.

documents.conditions: Must be certified copy issued by registrar or official authority with raised, embossed, or multicolored seal; hospital birth certificates not accepted.
accepted_alternatives: Consular Report of Birth Abroad (CRBA) Form FS-240
Full validity undamaged previous U.S. passport
documents.original_or_copy: Original or certified copy + 1 black and white photocopy
documents.translation_or_legalisation: Certified English translation if foreign document

documents.conditions: Must be valid and unexpired; out-of-state IDs may require secondary photo identification.
documents.original_or_copy: Original shown in person + photocopy of front and back on plain 8.5x11 paper

photo_rules.eyeglass_policy: Eyeglasses NOT permitted unless medical certificate of urgent need provided
photo_rules.expression: Neutral facial expression or natural smile, both eyes open

processing_times.urgent_travel: Within 14 calendar days at Passport Agency (appointment required with proof of travel)

eligibility.rule: Qualifies for Form DS-82 mail renewal if: existing passport is undamaged, issued within last 15 years, applicant was 16 or older at issuance, and name is unchanged or documented with legal name change.
If passport was issued before age 16 or expired >5 years ago (>15 years since issuance), applicant must use Form DS-11 in person.

steps.step: Complete Form DS-82 (Renew by Mail or Online Renewal if eligible).
Include most recent U.S. passport booklet.
Include one new 2x2 passport photo (staple with 4 vertical staples on corners).
Enclose check or money order payable to 'U.S. Department of State'.
Mail via USPS tracked priority mail to designated National Passport Processing Center.

documents.conditions: Must be submitted with application; will be cancelled and returned separately.

eligibility.rule: All children under 16 must apply in person with BOTH parents or legal guardians present.
If one parent cannot appear, notarized Form DS-3053 (Statement of Consent) + copy of front/back of non-applying parent's ID is mandatory.
Child passports are valid for 5 years and cannot be renewed by mail.

steps.step: Fill out Form DS-11.
Bring child in person to acceptance facility.
Both parents present valid government photo IDs and sign in front of agent.

documents.conditions: U.S. Birth Certificate listing parents' names, foreign birth certificate, or adoption decree.
documents.translation_or_legalisation: Certified English translation if in foreign language

sources.publisher: U.S. Department of State, Bureau of Consular Affairs

jurisdictions.name: United Kingdom (HMPO Online & Post Office Check & Send)
Applying from abroad (GOV.UK Overseas Passport Application)

eligibility.rule: Must have British nationality (British citizen, British overseas citizen, etc.).
First-time adult applicants (16+) may be invited to attend a 30-minute identity interview.

steps.step: Apply online at GOV.UK (or pick up a paper form from Post Office).
Get a digital photo code or upload a digital photo that meets HMPO criteria.
Provide details of a countersignatory / identity referee (must know applicant for 2+ years, British/Irish passport holder in recognized profession).
Post original supporting documents to the HMPO document handling address provided.

documents.document_name: Full Birth Certificate or Adoption Certificate
documents.conditions: Must show parents' details. Short birth certificates (without parents' names) are not accepted.
accepted_alternatives: Certificate of Naturalisation or Registration as a British Citizen
documents.original_or_copy: Original official certified copy (HMPO returns documents via secure courier)

documents.document_name: Parents' Birth Certificates / Marriage Certificate (if born in UK after 1 Jan 1983)
documents.conditions: Required to prove British citizenship was transmitted through parents at birth.
accepted_alternatives: Parent's British passport number at time of birth

photo_rules.background: Light grey or cream background (not pure white)
photo_rules.rules: Neutral expression, mouth closed, no smiling, no head covering unless religious or medical

sources.page_title: Apply Online for a UK Passport

eligibility.rule: Adult passports can be renewed online by submitting old passport by post.

steps.step: Complete online renewal at GOV.UK.
Pay £88.50 fee.
Post old passport to HMPO address provided.

documents.conditions: Must send current/expired passport booklet; corners will be clipped and returned.

CA.authority_name: Immigration, Refugees and Citizenship Canada (IRCC) · Passport Program

jurisdictions.name: Inside Canada (Service Canada Centers & Specialized Passport Offices)
Applying from USA or abroad (Canadian Embassies, High Commissions & Consulates)

eligibility.rule: Must be a Canadian citizen by birth or naturalization.
Requires an eligible Guarantor (knows applicant 2+ years, Canadian citizen with valid 5/10-year passport).
Requires 2 references (known applicant 2+ years, not family members).

steps.step: Complete Form PPTC 153 (Adult General Passport Application).
Have guarantor fill section 6 and sign back of 1 photo.
Submit original proof of Canadian citizenship and secondary photo ID.
Submit in person at Service Canada or mail application.

documents.conditions: Must be original document; photocopies not accepted.
Issued by federal, provincial or municipal authority; must contain name, sex, date of birth, photo and signature.
documents.original_or_copy: Original or signed copy (both sides signed by guarantor)

photo_rules.dimensions: 50 mm wide x 70 mm high (2 inches wide x 2 3/4 inches long)
photo_rules.photographer_stamp: Back of 1 photo must have photographer name, studio address and date taken stamped or written
photo_rules.guarantor_endorsement: Guarantor must write 'I certify this to be a true likeness of [Applicant Name]' and sign on back

eligibility.rule: Simplified Renewal: If old passport was 5 or 10 years, issued within last 15 years, and personal info unchanged, NO guarantor is required.

steps.step: Fill simplified renewal form PPTC 054.
Include old passport, 2 new photos, and 2 references.

documents.conditions: Original booklet submitted.

AU.authority_name: Australian Passport Office · Department of Foreign Affairs and Trade

jurisdictions.name: Australia (Australia Post retail outlets & Passport Offices)
Overseas (Australian High Commissions & Embassies)

eligibility.rule: Must be an Australian citizen.
First-time applicants must complete Form PC8 with an approved guarantor.

steps.step: Complete application form online at AusPassport portal, then print high-resolution copy.
Have guarantor fill section 11 and sign back of 1 photo in black ink.
Gather original proof of citizenship and identity documents from Combination 1 or 2.
Lodge in person at participating Australia Post post office.

documents.conditions: Full Australian birth certificate (issued by state/territory BDM) or Australian citizenship certificate.
documents.translation_or_legalisation: NAATI accredited English translation if foreign document

documents.document_name: Original Photo ID and Address Evidence
documents.conditions: Current Australian driver licence, Proof of Age card, or Medicare card + bank statement.

photo_rules.dimensions: 35 mm to 40 mm wide x 45 mm to 50 mm high
photo_rules.background: Plain white or light grey background
photo_rules.specifications: Edge-to-edge face measurement between 32 mm and 36 mm; no smiling, mouth closed

eligibility.rule: Adult Streamlined Renewal (Form PC7): Eligible if adult passport issued with at least 2 years validity after age 16, current name matches, and expired within last 3 years.

steps.step: Complete PC7 renewal online.
Bring old passport + 2 new photos to Australia Post; no guarantor needed.

documents.conditions: Must bring physical book.

PK.authority_name: Directorate General of Immigration & Passports · Ministry of Interior

jurisdictions.name: Domestic Regional Passport Offices (RPO) & Executive Passport Centers (EPC)
Overseas (Pakistan Missions Abroad & Online e-Services portal)

eligibility.rule: Must be a citizen of Pakistan with valid NADRA CNIC / SNIC (or NICOP/POC for overseas).

steps.step: Pay passport fee via National Bank of Pakistan (NBP), 1Link, or Passport Fee Asaan app.
Visit Regional Passport Office or Executive Passport Center in person with original CNIC/SNIC.
Undergo token generation, live photo capture, biometric fingerprint scanning, data entry, and interview.
Collect passport upon SMS notification or receive via courier.

documents.document_name: Original CNIC / Smart National Identity Card (SNIC)
documents.conditions: Must be valid and unexpired; for minors under 18, NADRA Child Registration Certificate (CRC / Form-B) + parents' CNICs.
accepted_alternatives: NICOP (National Identity Card for Overseas Pakistanis)

documents.conditions: Showing complete payment with PSID / tracking number.

photo_rules.details: Photo captured digitally at the counter; applicant should wear dark clothing with face and forehead unobstructed.

eligibility.rule: Eligible for renewal within 7 months of expiry or anytime after expiry; can be done online at onlinemrp.dgip.gov.pk if biometric data is active.

steps.step: Pay fee via online e-Services or NBP.
Bring original old passport and valid CNIC to passport office.

documents.conditions: Original booklet required for cancellation.

sources.publisher: Directorate General of Immigration & Passports, Pakistan

BD.authority_name: Department of Immigration and Passports · Ministry of Home Affairs

jurisdictions.name: Domestic (Regional Passport Offices)
Overseas (Bangladesh Missions Abroad)

eligibility.rule: Must be a citizen of Bangladesh holding a National ID Card (NID) or 17-digit online Birth Registration Certificate (BRC).

steps.step: Complete online application form at epassport.gov.bd.
Pay passport fee via bank / online payment gateway (A-Challan / bKash / cards).
Book appointment slot at designated Regional Passport Office (RPO).
Attend biometric appointment for photo, 10-finger scan and iris scan.
Police verification initiated automatically by Special Branch.

documents.document_name: Smart NID Card or National ID Card (or 17-digit English Birth Certificate)
documents.conditions: Adults 18+ must use NID; applicants under 18 must use digital 17-digit Birth Registration Certificate (BRC) verified on bdris.gov.bd.
Printed from e-Passport portal with barcode.

photo_rules.details: Taken at the passport office; infants under 6 must bring 3R size lab print white background photo.

sources.publisher: Department of Immigration and Passports, Bangladesh
Department of Immigration and Passports, Bangladesh

DE.authority_name: Auswärtiges Amt (Federal Foreign Office) & Bundesministerium des Innern und für Heimat (BMI)

jurisdictions.name: Domestic Germany (Local Bürgeramt / Passbehörde)
Overseas (German Embassies and General Consulates)

eligibility.rule: Must possess German citizenship (by birth, descent, adoption, or naturalization under Staatsangehörigkeitsgesetz).
Personal appearance is mandatory for all applicants regardless of age.

steps.step: Book appointment at your local Bürgeramt (or German mission if resident abroad).
Submit completed application form along with civil registry certificates.
Provide biometric photo and give fingerprints (fingerprint capture applies from age 6).
Pay passport fee and collect passport when ready (or authorize representative with proxy power).

documents.document_name: Birth Certificate (Geburtsurkunde) or Family Register (Auszug aus dem Heiratseintrag)
documents.conditions: Original official German birth certificate or extract from the civil marriage register; international multilingual CIEC certificates or certified translations required if foreign.
accepted_alternatives: Certified translation of foreign birth certificate by sworn translator
documents.translation_or_legalisation: Certified translation with Apostille/Legalisation if from outside EU

documents.conditions: Staatsangehörigkeitsausweis, naturalization certificate (Einbürgerungsurkunde), or valid/previous German identity document.
Required when applying at a German consular mission abroad to prove non-residence in Germany.
accepted_alternatives: Current proof of residence in host country

photo_rules.background: Plain light grey or neutral background (not pure white)
photo_rules.rules: Neutral expression, mouth closed, face centered, following German Fotomustertafel standards

processing_times.standard: 4 to 6 weeks (printed centrally by Bundesdruckerei in Berlin)

sources.page_title: German Passport and ID Card Services

eligibility.rule: Reisepass cannot be extended; an application for a new passport booklet must be filed upon expiry.

steps.step: Present previous passport booklet for cancellation.
Submit updated biometric photo and pay fee.

documents.conditions: Submitted for invalidation; can be returned to applicant upon request.

eligibility.rule: Note: Since Jan 1, 2024, the non-electronic Kinderreisepass has been abolished; children receive a standard electronic Reisepass valid for 6 years.
Both parents with joint legal custody (gemeinsames Sorgerecht) must sign consent and provide identity documents.

steps.step: Both parents and the child appear in person at the passport office.
Present child birth certificate and proof of custody.

documents.document_name: Proof of Custody & Both Parents' Passports
documents.conditions: If parents are separated or unmarried with joint custody, written consent and ID copy of absent parent required; if sole custody, court custody decree (Sorgerechtsbeschluss) or Negativbescheinigung from Jugendamt is required.

sources.publisher: Federal Ministry of the Interior, Germany
Bundesministerium des Innern und für Heimat

AE.authority_name: Federal Authority for Identity, Citizenship, Customs and Port Security (ICP)

jurisdictions.name: Inside UAE (ICP Smart Services & GDRFA Customer Happiness Centers)
Abroad (UAE Embassies & Consulates via Ministry of Foreign Affairs MoFA)

eligibility.rule: Must be a UAE national holding full citizenship status and registered in the Family Book (Khulasat Al Qaid).

steps.step: Log in to ICP smart channels (website or UAEICP app) using UAE PASS.
Select 'Issue Passport' service and fill in citizen details.
Upload high-resolution personal digital photo meeting ICAO standards.
Pay the issuance fee online via e-Dirham / card payment.
Receive passport via authorized express delivery (Emirates Post) or collect from ICP center.

documents.conditions: Must include the citizen's record; for newborns, digital addition to the family book must be completed first.
accepted_alternatives: Digital Family Book extract from ICP database

documents.conditions: Physical or digital Emirates ID via UAE PASS.

photo_rules.dimensions: High resolution digital photo, 4 x 6 cm
photo_rules.attire: UAE national dress (Kandura and Ghutra/Shemagh for men; Abaya/Sheyla for women) is customary and welcomed; face unobstructed

processing_times.urgent: Same day (available at designated Customer Happiness Centers and Dubai International Airport Terminal 3)

sources.publisher: Federal Authority for Identity, Citizenship, Customs and Port Security

eligibility.rule: Citizens can renew their passport within 6 months before expiry or anytime after expiry.

steps.step: Apply online via ICP portal or UAE PASS app for Renewal service.
Surrender previous expired passport upon receipt of new booklet.

documents.conditions: Must be submitted for cancellation.

sources.publisher: Federal Authority for Identity, Citizenship, Customs and Port Security

PH.authority_name: Department of Foreign Affairs (DFA) · Office of Consular Affairs

jurisdictions.name: Domestic Philippines (DFA Consular Offices & Temporary Off-Site Passport Services TOPS)
Overseas (Philippine Embassies and Consulates General via DFA FSP)

eligibility.rule: Must be a Filipino citizen by birth or naturalization under the Philippine Constitution and RA 8239.
Personal appearance at the DFA Consular Office is mandatory for all applicants.

steps.step: Book online appointment at passport.gov.ph (Appointment is free of charge; pay processing fee only).
Pay the processing fee through authorized DFA payment channels.
Appear in person on the appointed date with printed application form and original PSA documents.
Complete biometric capture (photo, fingerprints, iris scan, and signature).
Claim passport at the consular office or opt for courier delivery.

documents.document_name: Original Philippine Statistics Authority (PSA) Birth Certificate on Security Paper (SECPA)
documents.conditions: Must be clear and readable. If PSA birth certificate is blurred or unreadable, a certified true copy (CTC) transcribed from the Local Civil Registrar (LCR) is required.
accepted_alternatives: PSA Birth Certificate on Security Paper
LCR Transcribed Copy accompanied by PSA endorsement

documents.conditions: Accepted primary IDs: PhilSys National ID, SSS/GSIS/UMID, Driver's License, PRC ID, OWWA E-Card, Voter's ID.

documents.document_name: PSA Marriage Certificate (For married females using husband's surname)
documents.conditions: Required if a married woman chooses to adopt her husband's surname under Philippine Civil Code.
accepted_alternatives: PSA Marriage Certificate on Security Paper

photo_rules.details: Photo captured digitally at the consular counter; eyeglasses, contact lenses, facial piercings, and excessive makeup are prohibited.

sources.publisher: Department of Foreign Affairs, Republic of the Philippines

eligibility.rule: Holder of valid or expired standard ePassport (with electronic chip logo).

steps.step: Schedule appointment on passport.gov.ph.
Bring current ePassport and valid ID to appointment.

documents.conditions: Original booklet + photocopy of biographical page.

eligibility.rule: Minors under 18 must be accompanied by the mother, or father if married, or an authorized legal guardian.

steps.step: Accompanied personal appearance of child and parent.

documents.document_name: PSA Birth Certificate & Valid ID of Accompanying Parent
documents.conditions: If child is illegitimate, mother must appear or execute Special Power of Attorney (SPA).

FR.authority_name: Ministère de l'Intérieur · Agence Nationale des Titres Sécurisés (ANTS)

jurisdictions.name: Inside France (Any equipped Mairie town hall)
Abroad (Consulat général ou section consulaire de France)

eligibility.rule: Must prove French nationality (National Identity Card, birth certificate showing French parentage, or Certificat de Nationalité Française CNF).
Personal appearance is required at any Mairie equipped with biometric station; child must appear with parent.

steps.step: Complete online pre-application (pré-demande) on passeport.ants.gouv.fr.
Purchase fiscal stamp (timbre fiscal) online.
Book in-person appointment at an equipped Mairie or Consulate.
Submit original supporting documents, pay stamp, and record fingerprints (for applicants aged 12+).
Collect passport in person within 3 months of SMS receipt.

documents.document_name: French National Identity Card (CNI) or Birth Certificate (Acte de naissance)
documents.conditions: Valid CNI proves identity and nationality. If no valid CNI, full birth certificate (acte de naissance copie intégrale) issued within last 3 months is required if birthplace not connected to COMEDEC.
accepted_alternatives: Acte de naissance copie intégrale (less than 3 months old)

documents.conditions: Less than 1 year old (utility bill, tax notice, rent receipt).
Taken within last 6 months; background must be light grey or light blue; PURE WHITE BACKGROUND IS STRICTLY REJECTED in France.
accepted_alternatives: E-photo code with digital signature from approved booth
documents.original_or_copy: Original physical photo or e-photo code

photo_rules.background: Light grey or light blue; WHITE BACKGROUND IS STRICTLY FORBIDDEN IN FRANCE
photo_rules.rules: Neutral expression, mouth closed, no smiling, eyes open and looking at lens, hair away from face

processing_times.standard: 2 to 6 weeks depending on Mairie and seasonal demand

eligibility.rule: Can apply before expiry or when booklet is full.

steps.step: Complete pre-application on ANTS.
Present old passport and new photo at Mairie.

documents.conditions: Must be surrendered upon collection of new passport.

SA.authority_name: General Directorate of Passports (Al-Jawazat) · Ministry of Interior

jurisdictions.name: Inside Kingdom of Saudi Arabia (Absher Platform & Al-Jawazat Branches)
Abroad (Saudi Embassies & Royal Consulates via MOFA Saudi Arabia)

age_bands.label: Adult (20 and older - 5 or 10-year validity option)

eligibility.rule: Must be a Saudi citizen with a valid National Identity Card (Hawiyya Wataniyya) and registered National Address.
All traffic fines must be paid through SADAD prior to application submission.
Applicant must be present within the Kingdom at the time of application.

steps.step: Pay the passport issuance fee through SADAD electronic government payment system.
Log into the Absher portal (absher.sa) using your national ID credentials.
Navigate to My Services -> Passport Services -> Issue Saudi Passport.
Confirm applicant details and select validity period (5 or 10 years for age 20+).
Select delivery method via Saudi Post (SPL) to registered national address.

documents.document_name: Valid Saudi National Identity Card (Hawiyya Wataniyya)
documents.conditions: Must be active on Absher. Minors aged 10-15 must have their biometric record registered with Civil Affairs (Al-Ahwal Al-Madaniyya).
documents.original_or_copy: Digital record via Absher / Original ID

documents.conditions: Active registration in SPL Saudi Post address system.

photo_rules.details: Photo is retrieved automatically from the Civil Affairs (Al-Ahwal Al-Madaniyya) biometric database; must reflect current appearance with traditional national dress.

processing_times.standard: 3 to 5 business days for delivery via SPL

sources.publisher: Ministry of Interior, Kingdom of Saudi Arabia

eligibility.rule: Passport can be renewed if validity is less than 12 months remaining.

steps.step: Pay renewal fee via SADAD.
Apply for 'Renew Saudi Passport' on Absher.
Hand over old physical passport to SPL courier or Jawazat branch for cancellation.

documents.conditions: Must be submitted for cancellation.

JP.authority_name: Ministry of Foreign Affairs (MOFA - 外務省) · Prefectural Passport Offices

jurisdictions.name: Domestic (Prefectural Passport Divisions / Mynaportal)
Overseas Consular Services (Japanese Embassies & Consulates General)

eligibility.rule: Must possess Japanese nationality under the Nationality Act (国籍法).

Effective 1 July 2026, applicants aged 18 and over must apply for a 10-year passport (the adult 5-year passport option was discontinued for new adult applications). Minors under 18 receive a 5-year passport.

steps.step: Obtain a certified Family Register Certificate (戸籍謄本 - Koseki Tohon) issued within the last 6 months from your registered municipal office.
Complete the General Passport Application Form (一般旅券発給申請書) — 10-year validity for adults aged 18+, or 5-year validity for minors under 18.
Submit application with 1 compliant photo (45mm x 35mm) and primary photo ID (My Number Card, Driver's License) at your registered Prefectural Passport Office.
Collect passport in person and pay national/prefectural revenue stamps (収入印紙 and 都道府県手数料).

documents.document_name: Certified Family Register (Koseki Tohon - 戸籍謄本)
documents.conditions: Must be issued within 6 months. Since March 2023, Koseki Shohon extract is no longer accepted for new passport issuance; full Koseki Tohon is mandatory.
accepted_alternatives: Certified Copy of Family Register (Koseki Tohon)
Electronic Koseki verification via Mynaportal (where supported)

documents.conditions: Single document accepted: Japanese My Number Card, Driver's License, or Basic Resident Register Card with photo. If not available, two secondary IDs (Health Insurance Card + Pension Book/Student ID) are required.
accepted_alternatives: National Health Insurance Card + Pension Handbook

photo_rules.dimensions: 45mm x 35mm (head height from chin to crown 32mm to 36mm)
photo_rules.background: Plain white, off-white, or light grey without patterns or shadows
photo_rules.conditions: Taken within 6 months, neutral expression, mouth closed, no tinted glasses or thick frames.

fees.statutory_reform_notice: Effective 1 July 2026, domestic passport fees are differentiated by application channel (online vs counter), and the adult 5-year passport option was discontinued for applicants aged 18 and over under MOFA revision.

consular_overseas.currency_rule: Overseas consular fees are determined in local host currency under MOFA consular regulations and must not be confused with domestic fees.
consular_overseas.guidance: Applicants abroad must consult their local Japanese Embassy or Consulate-General portal for current local currency amounts and application guidelines.

fee_records.applicable_conditions: Japanese nationals aged 18+ applying online via Mynaportal.
Japanese nationals aged 18+ applying in person at prefectural passport counter.
Minors under 18 applying online via Mynaportal with statutory guardian signature.
Minors under 18 applying in person at prefectural passport counter with statutory guardian signature.

processing_times.domestic_standard: 6 to 8 business days (excluding weekends and public holidays)
processing_times.consular_overseas: 1 to 2 weeks depending on diplomatic mission

sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Japan (MOFA)
sources.page_title: Passport Fee Revision Guidance (Domestic Online & Counter)

sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Japan (MOFA)
Ministry of Foreign Affairs (Domestic Consular Services)

eligibility.rule: Available when remaining validity is less than 1 year, visa pages are exhausted, or the booklet is physically damaged.
If no change has occurred in name or Honseki prefecture, Koseki Tohon submission is waived; simply surrender the current valid passport.

steps.step: Submit renewal application in person at prefectural office or online via Mynaportal app (requires My Number Card).
Physically surrender current passport booklet at pickup for cancellation (hole-punching).

documents.conditions: Must be surrendered for physical cancellation upon receipt of new passport.

sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Japan

eligibility.rule: Applicants under 18 require the legal representative signature (法定代理人署名) of parent with parental authority (親権者).

steps.step: Parent or guardian signs Section 2 of application form; submit Koseki Tohon verifying parentage.

documents.conditions: Issued within 6 months.

Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Japan (MOFA)
sources.page_title: Passport Fee Revision Guidance (Domestic Online & Counter)

sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Japan (MOFA)
Ministry of Foreign Affairs (Domestic Consular Services)

MX.authority_name: Secretaría de Relaciones Exteriores (SRE - Ministry of Foreign Affairs)

jurisdictions.name: Domestic (SRE Delegations & Liaison Offices in Mexico)

eligibility.rule: Must prove Mexican nationality by birth or naturalization under Mexican law.
One-year passport validity is issued exclusively to children under three years of age to accommodate rapid biometric changes. It is not an emergency appointment qualification.
Applicants aged 3 to 17 may receive 3-year or 6-year passports. Adults aged 18+ may select 3-year, 6-year, or 10-year validity.

For acute emergencies abroad (loss, theft, destruction, or urgent unplanned travel), an Emergency Type E passport with limited validity may be requested subject to consular assessment and supporting documentation.

steps.step: Schedule mandatory appointment online via citas.sre.gob.mx or official WhatsApp service.
Pay passport fee at an authorized bank branch using official SRE payment slip (pago de derechos).
Attend appointment at SRE office with certified Birth Certificate, official photo ID, and payment proof.
Undergo live biometrics capture (photograph, fingerprints, iris scan) and receive passport the same day or within designated window.

eligibility_conditions.validity_1_year: The 1-year passport is issued exclusively to children under three years of age due to rapid developmental and biometric changes. It is not an emergency appointment document.
eligibility_conditions.discount_50_percent: Subject to documented eligibility for adults aged 60+, persons with certified disabilities, and agricultural workers under the Mexico-Canada SAWP programme.
eligibility_conditions.agricultural_worker_restriction: Temporary agricultural workers under the Mexico-Canada SAWP programme are NOT eligible for the discount on the 10-year passport (validity restricted to 3 or 6 years).
eligibility_conditions.emergency_appointments: Emergency non-scheduled appointments at Mexican consulates abroad (citas de emergencia) for standard biometric passports are subject to consular approval based on documented humanitarian, medical, academic, or employment urgency. Under Article 20 of the Ley Federal de Derechos, emergency consular processing incurs a statutory rounded surcharge (30%), added to the standard fee for the applicant eligible validity (1, 3, 6, or 10 years). Separately, in verified circumstances of loss, theft, destruction, acute unscheduled travel, or technical downtime where a standard biometric passport cannot be produced in time, an Emergency Type E Passport (Pasaporte de Emergencia Tipo E) with limited validity (up to 1 year) may be issued upon consular assessment under embassy-specific protocols (e.g. SRE Embamex Polonia). An emergency appointment for a standard passport does not automatically restrict or qualify an applicant for a 1-year document.

eligibility.rule: Mexican citizens whose passport has been lost, stolen, or destroyed must report the loss to local authorities and may apply for replacement at an SRE delegation (domestically) or Mexican embassy/consulate abroad.

For urgent travel abroad following loss, theft, or destruction, an Emergency Type E Passport (Pasaporte de Emergencia Tipo E) with limited validity may be requested subject to consular assessment and documentary proof of emergency.

steps.step: File an official police report (acta de robo o extravío) with the local police or civil authority immediately upon discovering the loss.
Schedule an appointment at an SRE delegation (in Mexico) or Mexican embassy/consulate abroad. For acute overseas travel emergencies, contact the consular section via emergency consular email.
Present the police report, proof of Mexican nationality, government-issued photo ID, and evidence of emergency travel if requesting emergency Type E issuance.

eligibility.rule: Must be a Brazilian citizen by birth or naturalization.
Must be in regular standing with the Electoral Court (Justiça Eleitoral) and Military Service (for males 18-45).

steps.step: Fill out electronic application form on gov.br Polícia Federal passport portal.
Generate GRU (Guia de Recolhimento da União) payment slip and pay fee via banking network or PIX.
Book in-person appointment at nearest Polícia Federal station (Posto de Emissão de Passaportes).
Attend appointment with original identity document, CPF, civil certificate, and have biometrics/photo captured live.
Collect passport in person within 90 days (uncollected passports are canceled and destroyed).

documents.document_name: Official Brazilian Identity Document (Documento de Identidade)
documents.conditions: Must be valid and unexpired. Digital identity documents (e-Título with photo, CNH Digital, RG Digital) are accepted via official government apps.

documents.conditions: Must be registered and in regular standing with Receita Federal. If CPF number is printed on RG or CNH, separate card is not required.

photo_rules.exception_for_infants: Children under 3 years old may be required to bring 1 physical 5x7 cm colour photograph on plain white background if unable to hold pose for live capture.

steps.step: Submit online form on gov.br, pay standard fee, and present current passport at PEP appointment.

Pay €42.50 booklet fee via pre-printed postal bulletin (bollettino postale c/c 67428014 payable to Ministero dell'Economia e delle Finanze).
Attend appointment at Questura or Commissariato with 2 photos, payment receipts, identity card, and submit digital fingerprints.
Collect electronic biometric passport in person or via Poste Italiane home delivery service (€9.55).

Print the identity verification form and have it witnessed in person by an approved professional (Garda, lawyer, doctor, accountant, teacher, or bank manager).
Post the original supporting documents (civil birth certificate, witnessed form, photo ID, proof of address and name) to the Passport Service in Dublin or Cork.
Track application progress via the DFA Passport Tracking system; passport and documents are returned by registered post.

Obtain queue token, complete biometric photograph and thumbprint scanning at the counter.

Collect the passport within 1 hour after payment completion (standard domestic service benchmark).

eligibility.rule: Malaysian adults aged 13 and above can renew their passport online via MyOnline Pasport if the existing passport is in good physical condition.

Collect the new passport in person at the selected immigration collection center upon presenting MyKad and old passport booklet.

Parent signs statutory consent declaration and completes biometric photo capture.

Legal parent registered on birth certificate.
Original card.

eligibility.rule: Under Malaysian law, losing a passport carries a statutory investigation and fine: MYR 400 for 1st loss, MYR 700 for 2nd loss, and MYR 1,200 for 3rd loss (plus the MYR 200 booklet fee).

steps.step: Immediately lodge a police report at the nearest Royal Malaysia Police (PDRM) station.
Appear in person at the State Immigration Enforcement / Passport Division with police report, MyKad, and Birth Certificate for investigation interview.
Pay the statutory fine plus passport fee upon approval.

documents.conditions: Original certified police report detailing circumstances of loss or theft.
Identity and citizenship evidence.

Pay the statutory fee through ConnectIPS, bank voucher, or designated revenue counter.
Attend appointment with printed pre-enrollment slip, original Citizenship Certificate, and verified NID number for live biometric photo, fingerprints, and iris capture.
Collect the e-Passport upon receiving SMS notification from the issuing office.

documents.conditions: Issued by District Administration Office.

Attend appointment with existing passport booklet, Citizenship certificate, and NID number.

documents.conditions: Original old passport booklet.
Original Nagarikta and verified NID.

Child and parent appear in person at DAO or DoP with original birth certificate, Nabalak Parichayapatra, parents citizenship, and marriage registration certificate.

documents.conditions: Issued by District Administration Office.
Both parents Nagarikta and formal civil marriage registration.

eligibility.rule: Lost or damaged passports require an official Nepal Police report and carry a double fee penalty (NPR 10,000 at DAO / NPR 17,000 at DoP Kathmandu).

steps.step: Obtain official police loss verification report from Nepal Police.
Pre-enroll online under Lost/Damaged category and attend appointment with police report and Nagarikta.

documents.conditions: Official police verification report certifying passport loss.
Original documents.

eligibility.rule: New Zealand citizens can apply online via passports.govt.nz using a RealMe verified account or standard online identity check.

steps.step: Apply online at passports.govt.nz, upload a compliant digital photo, and enter details of an identity referee.
The identity referee confirms the applicants identity online via email verification (referee must be a NZ passport holder who has known applicant for >1 year).
Pay the statutory fee online by credit or debit card.
Receive passport securely by tracked courier to your home or office address in NZ or overseas.

Pay NZD 215 fee online. Old passport is cancelled electronically upon dispatch of the new passport.

documents.conditions: Entered into online renewal portal.

Parent completes legal declaration of guardianship.

documents.conditions: Submitted online by authorized guardian.

eligibility.rule: Singapore citizens must submit applications online through MyICA using Singpass authentication.
Passports issued to citizens aged 16 and above have a 10-year validity. Children under 16 are issued 5-year passports.

steps.step: Log in to MyICA using Singpass, complete online application form, and upload passport photo meeting ICA specifications.
Pay the SGD 70 application fee online via PayNow, credit/debit card, or internet banking.
Book collection appointment online upon receiving email/SMS notification that passport is ready.
Collect passport in person at selected SingPost post office, or at ICA Building via automated iCollect biometric kiosks.

documents.conditions: Taken within last 3 months, plain white background, matt or semi-matt finish, even lighting without shadows or glasses glare.
Mandatory for citizens aged 15 and above upon collection.

Bring existing physical passport upon collection for invalidation.

documents.conditions: Must be brought to collection appointment for physical cancellation.

steps.step: Parent logs into MyICA, selects Child Passport, inputs child birth certificate number, and uploads child photo.
Parent collects passport with child (child must be present for biometric identity confirmation if aged 6 and above).

documents.conditions: Verified electronically against Dukcapil/ICA national registries.

eligibility.rule: Lost passports must be reported immediately via MyICA e-Service. First loss carries a statutory penalty of SGD 50; repeat loss within 3 years carries SGD 100 penalty.

steps.step: Report lost passport immediately online through MyICA Report Lost Passport e-Service.
If stolen or lost overseas, lodge a report with the local police department.
Apply for replacement passport online and pay replacement fee plus loss penalty.

documents.conditions: Police report mandatory if passport was stolen or lost through crime.

Validity: 2 years for children under 5; 5 years for applicants aged 5 to 29; 10 years for adults aged 30 and older.

Attend appointment at designated Comisaría de Policía with valid DNI, photograph, and statutory fee.
Provide live fingerprints, verify digital data on counter terminal, and pay €30.00 in cash or card (or pre-paid online).
Receive the physical biometric electronic passport immediately in person before leaving the counter.

eligibility.rule: Sri Lankan citizens may apply for an All Countries passport under Normal Service or Urgent One-Day Service at the Battaramulla Head Office.
Standard All Countries passport is valid for 10 years. For minors under 16, a 3-year minor passport option is also available.

steps.step: Obtain digital photograph from an authorized Department-approved studio across Sri Lanka and receive studio acknowledgment receipt with barcode.
Reserve appointment slot online via immigration.gov.lk or report to Head Office Battaramulla / Regional Office with queue token.
Submit completed Form K 35 A with original birth certificate, NIC, photo receipt, and pay statutory fee (LKR 10,000 normal / LKR 20,000 one-day urgent).
Collect the passport on the same day (Urgent One-Day service) or receive via Speed Post / courier within 2–3 weeks (Normal service).

documents.conditions: Certified copy issued by the Divisional Secretariat within the last 3–6 months. Probable age birth certificates not accepted without supporting records.

eligibility.rule: Indonesian citizens applying for the first time must book an appointment via the official Aplikasi M-Paspor and appear in person at Kantor Imigrasi.
Under Permenkumham No. 18/2022 and PP No. 51/2020, passports with 10-year validity are granted to Indonesian citizens aged 21 and above or married. Minors under 21 receive 5-year validity.

steps.step: Download Aplikasi M-Paspor, register an account, upload scanned original identity documents, and select an immigration office and appointment slot.
Pay the PNBP passport fee within 2 hours of booking using the billing code via MPN G2/G3, ATM, internet banking, or convenience stores.
Attend the scheduled Kantor Imigrasi appointment with original physical documents for document verification, live biometric photo capture, fingerprints, and interview.
Collect the completed passport in person after 3–4 working days (or same day if percepatan fee was paid).

Attend appointment at Kantor Imigrasi with e-KTP and existing passport booklet for biometric verification.

Appear in person at Kantor Imigrasi for formal interrogation and drafting of Berita Acara Pemeriksaan (BAP).
Upon approval of the BAP by the Head of the Immigration Office, pay the statutory fine (IDR 1,000,000 for loss) plus the new passport booklet fee.
